pages.title: Supersymmetry
pages.text: $(thing)Supersymmetry$()$(br2)Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): The Standard Model, The Dark Sector, Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Standard Model Matrix.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Stable heavy particles of number density n fill the early universe, which expands at rate H. They annihilate in pairs with velocity-averaged cross-section σv and are re-created from the thermal bath, which by itself would hold the equilibrium density n_eq. Write the rate of change of n including dilution by expansion in three dimensions.
